title: icosbase
description: The shared ICOS base image, built on a 2026-pinned Jupyter datascience notebook, with its Python, R and Julia kernels. Ships the geospatial and visualization stack, including cartopy, folium, geoviews, holoviews, ipyleaflet and xarray, the GDAL and CDO command-line tools with their Python bindings, pangaeapy, and the ICOS libraries (icoscp_core, icoscp, icoscp_stilt, fluxie). TeX Live is not installed.
